criteria.reason: Direct verdict: don't hide keys; gradual least-invasive path (talk, doctor, alternatives, authority) still protecting safety.
Names father's autonomy/dignity versus safety of him and other road users; advice structured around this balance.
Correctly explains doctor's report to cantonal road traffic authority; family reporting framed as option, not certain duty.
Conditional 'puoi/se necessario', respectful tone toward father, final decision left with family.
